title: papyrus-infra deploy tooling and p.apyr.us edge codified from the owning build (#350 to #363)
description: Filed 2026-10-20 to record merged work that named no issue. On 2026-10-19 these PRs merged to develop: #350 (6d44a535) codify the p.apyr.us reader and marketing edge; #351 (c1e0a1c7) papyrus-infra deploy runs the app-shell stack deploy from the owning Amplify build; #352 (7ba70e63) deploy-edge adopts live resources into an edge stack; #354 (0c4bef22) deploy takes account and region from the build credentials; #355 (9a05a3b4) deploy synthesizes first and deploys the synthesized directory; #357 (8f060240) deploy-edge takes template defaults for new parameters; #359 (25b9b6e9) quoting and parameter fixes released; #363 (f7c383c8) CDK account resolved via STS with no legacy default. Related docs: aa7a9523 (p.apyr.us edge adoption runbook), a9a6b0b5 (#260). PPY-1ad3c8 (closed) records only the #363 STS fix; this record covers the rest of the series.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Closing as a record of finished work: all PRs listed in the description merged to develop on 2026-10-19 and are on main; this issue exists only so the work is findable on the board. The CDK-account-via-STS change (#363) is what PPY-1ad3c8 tracks.
